notes: No more OK after typing the app lock code: it is checked as soon as the last digit is in, and a wrong code clears so you can start again. A code set on an older version still needs OK once, then never again. The same goes for the Telegram login code: the last digit sends it, and a wrong code is cleared. Fixed movies that stopped with "This video can't be played" every time, after the cache had removed their half-downloaded copy. They now download again and play.

No more OK after typing the app lock code: it is checked as soon as the last digit is in, and a wrong code clears so you can start again. A code set on an older version still needs OK once, then never again.
The same goes for the Telegram login code: the last digit sends it, and a wrong code is cleared.
Fixed movies that stopped with "This video can't be played" every time, after the cache had removed their half-downloaded copy. They now download again and play.
While a movie plays, P+ and P− on the remote play the next or previous movie of the same channel, without going back to the list. The new title shows at the bottom.
New setting, **Resume a movie**: when you open a movie you stopped part-way, the app can ask (as before), resume straight away, or always start from the beginning.
The home screen title has a camera icon, and Edit sources and Settings are now icon buttons (a pencil and a gear).
The update prompt now lists everything that changed since your version, not just the newest release.

Telega Watch now sends a small, silent heartbeat to your own statistics server: the app version, the TV model and Android version, and the Telegram account it is logged in to. It never includes your phone number or what you watch. After you log out, the account is no longer sent.
Movie cards are more compact: the title takes one line, and a long title scrolls when the card is selected. The quality, year, episode and size share one line underneath.
A new app icon: the Telegram logo with a small camera.

App lock: set a code in Settings → App lock, and Telega Watch asks for it when it opens or comes back. You choose how long you can be away before it asks again. It can also lock after a period without a remote press; a playing movie never counts. If you forget the code, "Forgot code? Log out" resets it.
Saved Messages can be chosen as a source, so videos you saved to yourself show up like any channel.
Updates now arrive on the TV itself: Telega Watch offers each new version when it starts, or from Settings → Check for updates.
